brief: The “Coconut Palm Insurance Scheme (CPIS)” is being implemented by the Coconut Development Board, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India with the objective of insuring coconut palms against natural calamities, climatic risks, pests, diseases, and other perils.

name: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS)
tags: Technical Education; Research Grant; Financial Assistance
brief: Collaborative Research Scheme (CRS) has been introduced by the All India Council for Technical Education to support innovation & research across institutes with collaboration among TEQIP Faculty, Regular faculty of Project institutions (focus and non-focus) & Premier institutions of the country.

name: Supporting Community Radio Movement in India

brief: The GOI has a policy for grant of License to eligible organisations for setting up of Community Radio Stations. To support the Sector, the Scheme provides financial assistance once the Community Radio is made operational by eligible organisation. The Scheme also has components for capacity building.

name: Coaching Schemes For Sc/st/obc (non-creamy Layer) & Minority Students For Universities
tags: Coaching; Scheduled Caste; Scheduled Tribe; Other Backward Classes; Students

name: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Tribes (ST) Students
tags: Higher Education; Scholarship Scheme; Overseas; Financial Assistance
brief: A scholarship scheme by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs for regular, full-time ST students to obtain higher education (post-graduate courses viz. Masters, Ph.D. and Post-Doctoral Research) from foreign institutes/universities. The Scheme is implemented through the Indian Embassies.

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Upgradation of Merit of Scheduled Caste Students
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
tags: Student; School; Education; Scholarship; Merit

ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
tags: Scheduled Caste; Scheduled Tribe; Relief; Rehabilitation; Marriage; Court
brief: The scheme aims to ensure effective implementation of Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and Prevention of Atrocities Act, 1989. It provides relief, rehabilitation, and support to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes victims of atrocities and incentives for inter-caste marriages.

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC Students for studying in India
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
tags: Scholarship; Other Backward Class; OBC; DBT; Post-Matric; Education
brief: The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to OBC students studying at the post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education. These scholarships shall be available for studies in India only and will be disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
tags: Scholarship; Other Backward Class; OBC; Pre-Matric; Student

name: Central Sector Scheme for Rehabilitation of Bonded Labourer
tags: Rehabilitation; Labour; DBT; Trafficking; Social Justice
brief: The scheme addresses eradicating bonded labour in India. It introduces varying rehabilitation assistance amounts based on beneficiary categories, such as adults, children, women, and extreme cases, with provisions for annuity schemes and Direct Benefit Transfer.

name: Pradhan Mantri Uchchatar Shiksha Protsahan (PM-USP) Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University students
tags: Scholarship; Student; Financial Assistance; College; University
brief: A scholarship scheme by the Dept. of Higher Education to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from poor families to meet a part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. The scholarships are awarded on the basis of results of Higher Secondary / Class 12th Board Exam

name: Craftsmen Training Scheme
ministry: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
tags: Craftsmen; Training; Skill; Employment; Youth

tags: Credit Linked Subsidy; Coir Production; Enterprises; Coir Board
brief: The scheme "Coir Udyami Yojana" by the Coir Board, Ministry of MSME, Government of India, aims to modernize the coir industry and generate rural employment. It offers credit-linked financial assistance to establish coir units by eligible applicants.

ministry: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
tags: Internship; Law; Information Technology; Student; Vigilance
brief: CVC initiated an Internship Scheme in the year 2016. This Scheme seeks to engage Indian Nationals, who are Graduates (awaiting final year results) /Post Graduate or Research Students enrolled in reputed Universities/Institutions in India or abroad.

name: Coir Vikas Yojana- Coir Industry Technology Upgradation Scheme

brief: The scheme aims to utilize the expertise of retired scientists, engineers, and technologists by providing honorarium and research support for carrying out research and development activities in identified areas of the Department of Atomic Energy.

tags: Loan; Skill; Employment; SHG

tags: Fellowship; Financial Assistance; Research

brief: Dr. D.S. Kothari Post Doctoral Fellowships in Sciences was introduced by the UGC. In addition to the existing RA/PDF positions provided by various funding agencies, a need was felt for a PDF scheme running in a flexible mode, with fast track, online handling, and decision-making.

brief: The scheme aims to ensure dignified livelihood opportunities for Persons with Disabilities (PwDs) by providing industry-relevant and customized training specific to each group. brief: The Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR) offers Doctoral Fellowships to support full-time Ph.D. scholars engaged in high-quality research in the field of social and human sciences. tags: Production Linked Incentive Scheme; Telecom Equipments; Networking Products; Electronic Manufacturing; Make In India
brief: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme aims to boost domestic manufacturing, investments and export in the telecom and networking products The PLI Scheme will be implemented within the overall financial limits of ₹ 12,195 Crores only (Rupees Twelve Thousand One Hundred and Ninety-Five Crore only)

tags: Internship; DPIIT; Student; Under Graduate; Post Graduate; Research Scholar
brief: DPIIT has introduced an internship scheme for students pursuing Under Graduate/Post Graduate degrees or Research Scholars enrolled in recognized universities/Institutions within India or abroad. The applicants can choose the period of their choice ranging from one/two/three months.

name: Design Scheme Under MSME Innovative Scheme
ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
tags: Product Design; Product Development; Financial Support; Business & Entrepreneurship
brief: Design scheme will help MSMEs to avail advice on all aspects of design. It helps MSMEs realize and achieve their design-related objectives. This specialist advice will be provided by experienced designers for new product development as well as enhancing existing product portfolio.

tags: Coffee; Agriculture; Farmer; Plantation; Subsidy
brief: The objective of the scheme "Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Replantation" is to improve the production and productivity of coffee plantations by encouraging replantation of old/senile and unproductive plantations with high-yielding, disease-tolerant coffee varieties.

tags: Coffee; Farmer; Agriculture; Subsidy; DBT
brief: The objective of the scheme is to extend support to small and tiny growers, incentivizing them to form collectives/ Self Help Groups/ Cooperatives, thus encouraging them to take up marketing of coffee produced on a community-based approach through suitable financial incentives.

tags: Coffee; Farmer; Water; Subsidy; DBT
brief: The scheme "Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, aims to improve the production and productivity of coffee plantations by encouraging water augmentation in traditional areas.

name: Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship
tags: Fellowship; Research
brief: The scheme "Dr. S. Radhakrishnan UGC Post-Doctoral Fellowship" is a fellowship scheme by the University Grants Commission (UGC), Department of Higher Education (DoHE). Post-doctoral research is an important enabling step in grooming young researchers for launching an academic/research career.

name: AICTE-INAE Distinguished Visiting Professorship Scheme
tags: Fellowship; Distinguished Engineers; Engineer Scientists; Technologists; Visiting Professorship
brief: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE) distinguished visiting Professor scheme envisages promotion of industry-institute interaction.

tags: E-YUVA; Innovation; Fellow; Translational Research; Fellowship; Post Graduate

name: E-YUVA Scheme: E-YUVA Centers
tags: E-YUVA; Centers; University; Institution; Bio-incubator; Infrastructure; Equipment
brief: E-YUVA Centers are housed within the University/Institute set-up. It acts as an anchor and extends requisite support and mentoring to students. name: Electronics Component Manufacturing Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
tags: Supply Chain; Manufacturing Of Electronics; Incentives; Limited Liability Partnerships; Electronics System Design; Electronics System Manufacturing
brief: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives for manufacturing electronic components in Bharat. Through this scheme, turnover and capital expenditure-linked incentives are provided to companies and Limited Liability Partnerships.

brief: The scheme aims to encourage the demand for environment-friendly products that cause lesser adverse impacts on the environment. It provides an Ecomark label for products meeting specified environmental criteria to eligible producers, manufacturers, importers, and exporters.

name: Scheme of Human Resources Development in Sports- Exchange of Knowledge / Research / Ideas for Attending Seminars, Workshops and Conferences of Repute in India or Abroad
tags: Research; Seminars; Workshops; Conference; Financial Assistance
brief: The scheme aims to enhance professional knowledge and skills in sports. Financial assistance is provided to eligible professionals for participating in reputed seminars, workshops and conferences.

tags: Education Loan Scheme Of NMDFC

brief: The objective of the EPCG Scheme is to facilitate import of capital goods for producing quality goods and services and enhance India’s manufacturing competitiveness. EPCG scheme allows import of capital goods for pre-production, production and post-production at zero customs duty.

brief: The scheme ensures retirement security for employees covered under the Code on Social Security, 2020, offering monthly pensions, family pensions, and withdrawal benefits. brief: The scheme “Financial Assistance for Development of Buddhist/Tibetan Arts and Culture” was launched by the Ministry of Culture, Government of India to provide financial assistance to voluntary Buddhist/Tibetan organizations including Monasteries.
